The '''Chancellor's working office''', also known as the '''holding office''', was a private sanctum located in the [[Chancellery Secretariat/Legends|Chancellery Secretariat]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. The holding office was positioned directly beneath the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]].

==History==
[[File:YodaPalpsduel.png|thumb|left|220px|Master Yoda duels Darth Sidious in the holding chamber]]
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] retreated to his holding office to receive a report from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Sidious was confronted in his office by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who [[Telekinesis/Legends|knocked]] the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|guards]] out before challenging the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] himself. The epic [[Skirmish in the Senate|lightsaber duel]] that followed progressed into the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]], which rose up into the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Chamber]]. The fight ended in the main chamber when Yoda was beaten and sent falling to the floor.

Following the Declaration of a New Order, Sidious moved his office to a new [[Imperial throne room (Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center)|throne room]] in the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|EmPal SuRecon]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Intendant caste|Intendant]] [[Nom Anor]] used the chamber to house his secret escape craft.

==Layout==
As with all of the Supreme Chancellor's residences, this chamber saw itself redecorated with each election. A circular chamber with a single door, the center of the chamber was dominated by the Chancellor's Podium. At the start of Senate sessions, the ceiling of the office would iris open, and the Podium, containing the Chancellor and his [[Aide/Legends|aides]], rose up into the center of the Senate Chamber. The floor was polished, with carpeting in certain areas.

During the chancellery of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], the office was bathed in rich oils, and the walls covered in [[Painting/Legends|paintings]]. The wide floor area was dotted with furniture and statues collected over a long history of Chancellors. Finis Valorum used this chamber as his principal office during his tenure as Supreme Chancellor prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

When Valorum was ousted and Palpatine voted as his successor, the holding office was redecorated as a minimal affair with a simple black desk to the right. On it, there was a lamp resembling the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] itself, while plush chairs could be brought before the desk to accommodate guests. Against the wall opposite the door, two floor-to-ceiling columns rose, projecting between them a view of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] as seen from the apex of the building.
